name: Nimura Kyouji
source:
He is the protagonist of this work and the older brother of Shougo, the protagonist of the previous work. He is usually a young businessman who runs a seaside inn.

He is a young businessman who runs a seaside inn. This time, he takes a liking to the Hidaka family, who visit the inn, and plots to win them over. 

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/kk/character.html#Chara05]Official website[/url]]
